# Bronze buckler

Internal ID: ShieldBronzeBuckler | Type: Shield | Source: Forge | Usage: Blocking | Wielding: Off-hand | Crafting Materials: Bronze x10, Wood x2 | Movement speed: -5%

# Introduction

The Bronze buckler is the first buckler shield. Its 2.5x parry bonus makes it superior for parrying attacks in comparison to even tower shields blocking in the same tier, but inferior for blocking to other options.

## Upgrade information

The cost to max is 25 Bronze(50 copper and 25 tin), and 7 wood
